pro_course_detail.title: Speaking with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description: These fluency-based lessons will help you to speak English more confidently with friends and colleagues in social settings such as dinners, parties, in meetings, and on holiday. You will learn how to open a conversation, how to answer questions, how to develop a conversation, and most importantly what to do when you don't understand. We will learn the value of question tags (won't we?), what topics to avoid, and how to use stress to show interest in what another person is saying. By the end, you will feel far more confident whenever you have to speak English. (PLEASE NOTE: This is NOT an IELTS Preparation course. If you are preparing for IELTS, please book an IELTS Speaking / Writing / Complete lesson instead)

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Complete
pro_course_detail.description: In this course David, an experienced IELTS examiner, will guide you through all 4 parts of the IELTS exam. We will learn about different question types, how examiners grade your answers, techniques to maximise your score, how to make the best use of your time, and how to avoid the most common mistakes. After each lesson you will be given real IELTS questions to practice, and you will get feedback on everything you do. I have examined hundreds of IELTS candidates over the years, and will give you the precise guidance you need to succeed in the IELTS exam.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking - your guide to success

We will practice each part of the test using real IELTS questions, and you will get detailed feedback on every part of your performance. By the end, you will feel confident about succeeding in this part of the IELTS exam.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing - the right way

After each lesson you will be given real IELTS questions to practice, and you will get feedback on everything you write. I have marked hundreds of IELTS writing answers over the years, and will give you the precise guidance you need to succeed in this part of the exam.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Garden

David has been teaching English grammar for over 20 years, to thousands of students from all over the world. So join his grammar garden, and let your English grow.

teacher_info.introduction: Learning a language can be a fascinating journey. Not only the adventure of learning new words and the challenges and excitement about constructing them into sentences and dialogue, but also the fun of understanding another culture. Language is the tool which brings us together and helps us develop an understanding of, and an appreciation for, the world beyond our own backyard. It expands our minds as well as our vocabularies. I have been teaching English online one-on-one for 5 years, mostly with intermediate to advanced level students. As well as having a certificate in TESOL, I have a degree in humanities and masters degrees in Celtic Studies and Fine Arts. I work as an artist and a teacher of English, and my varied work background means that I can help a wide variety of learners with their particular needs; business English, academic English, and just learning to widen your horizons. I have taught both adults and children. My philosophy is to learn by practical application, and while grammar is very important, I find that many students whose previous study has been a little too "book centred" become too hung up on grammatical correctness which impedes their confidence in speaking. By speaking and listening we learn organically, like we learnt our native language as babies, and so I focus on that as being the core of our lessons. Through the practical mechanism of speaking/listening we explore grammar and vocabulary, letting them build naturally. I find that student's confidence quickly grows when they find themselves talking more fluently.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I took my TESOL certificate while I was working on my MFA in Painting. It was my "back up plan", but I have been using it ever since. I love helping students gain confidence and linguistic skills, often alongside other scholastic or academic endeavours. I specialise in academic English and examination preparation, but I also have extensive experience teaching children from the age of 5. I believe that the key to teaching is patience, flexibility, and an understanding of a student's needs. I do not adhere strictly to any particular methodology, as I feel there is no one-size-fits-all approach to teaching.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Lessons can be as structured or as flexible as a student requires. Especially with children I think that language needs to be acquired rather than forced, and I use a variety of materials such as books, flashcards, videos, quizzes and games. With adults I encourage students to bring projects or work from their employment/school/university so that language can be applicable immediately to real world scenarios. I feel that one of the biggest obstacles to language acquisition can be the rather dull nature of some of the materials that are available, which is why I use a combination. I do not as a rule assign homework, but rather encourage students to engage widely with English outside of class.

I design each lesson based on the student's needs. 

For this, I ask for areas that they hold a specific interest (eg hobbies, academic pursuits, industry  etc), then will look for material around this area. 

This way we build conversational classes - which ALWAYS have CORRECTION & REVISION of learned terms - around areas that the student has an interest in.

By using this method, the student gets LANGUAGE INPUT, in homework, before the class, & then review during, followed by review in the next class. 

Together with conversation-with-correction, this combination produces fast & effective results in language acquisition.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I am a big believer in conversational classes, but these will ALWAYS come with a structure, and a focus on LANGUAGE ACQUISITION, not just a friendly chat! 

I ALWAYS give CORRECTION, & keep records of the vocabulary & language that has come up, send these to the student, and begin each class with short (fun!) tests.

This repetition is how the mind learns, and in all my time teaching, this method has proved the fastest and most efficient way for success.

pro_course_detail.title: Fast Track English!!! Join The A2 To B2 Language Gym Classes
pro_course_detail.description:
These are classes i've designed specifically to drill the fundamentals of English, and practise regularly occurring vocabulary, in different contexts. 

We will work through a 3000 word vocabulary list, that makes up the fundamentals of English, by exploring their meaning, presenting new sentences with them, forming your own and then your doing HW of fill-the-gap tasks of the new words. 

This method of key-word focus, combined with reading and forming new sentences with them is highly effective in learning the fundamentals of English, and is a great way to improve quickly. 

As always in my classes, REVIEW is vital, as is simple homework tasks. I will of course correct pronunciation. The grammar is contained within the sentences, and you will learn in context, which is the most EFFICIENT way to learn. 

For fast results, it's best to use these classes frequently, and in shorter lesson times. Ideally 3 classes a week, of 30 or 45 mins. If you follow this method & do the hometasks, you will see FAST IMPROVEMENTS in your journey towards fluency. 

For students of this level, if you are RESULTS DRIVEN and prepared to work, you will benefit far more from this approach than the standard conversation with correction model.
